changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: Keep the larger booking gap as one symmetric buffer, including Envers history.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE BookingConfiguration SET bufferBeforeMinutes = CASE WHEN bufferBeforeMinutes IS NULL AND bufferAfterMinutes IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(bufferBeforeMinutes, 0), COALESCE(bufferAfterMinutes, 0)) END

UPDATE BookingConfigurationDefaults SET bufferBeforeMinutes = CASE WHEN bufferBeforeMinutes IS NULL AND bufferAfterMinutes IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(bufferBeforeMinutes, 0), COALESCE(bufferAfterMinutes, 0)) END

UPDATE BookingConfiguration_AUD SET bufferBeforeMinutes = CASE WHEN bufferBeforeMinutes IS NULL AND bufferAfterMinutes IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(bufferBeforeMinutes, 0), COALESCE(bufferAfterMinutes, 0)) END

UPDATE BookingConfigurationDefaults_AUD SET bufferBeforeMinutes = CASE WHEN bufferBeforeMinutes IS NULL AND bufferAfterMinutes IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(bufferBeforeMinutes, 0), COALESCE(bufferAfterMinutes, 0)) END
